name: Gossip Menu
description: Gossip menus opened when a player interacts with a creature or gameobject (assigned via GossipMenuId in creature_template or gameobject template data). Each row binds the menu to an npc_text; multiple rows with different conditions select which text is shown, and script_id can run a dbscripts_on_gossip script when the menu is displayed.

fields.name: Text
fields.help: Open the npc_text row shown by this menu.

fields.name: Script Id
fields.help: Id of a dbscripts_on_gossip script executed when this menu is shown. 0 = none.

fields.name: Condition Id
fields.help: Entry in the `conditions` table that must be satisfied for this row to be used. 0 = always.

fields.name: Condition
fields.help: Edit the condition tree controlling whether this menu entry is shown.
fields.meta: mangos_conditions:condition_id;source=the NPC / GO the menu belongs to;target=Player

fields.name: Options
fields.help: Open the gossip_menu_option editor for this menu.
